summary: Valley National Bancorp filed a prospectus supplement for a $500M offering of 6.219% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036. The notes bear fixed interest at 6.219% until June 1, 2031, then float at SOFR plus 243 bps. Proceeds to the issuer are $495.75M after underwriting discounts. Redemption is at par upon optional call from 2031 or upon a tax/capital event, subject to Federal Reserve approval. The notes are unsecured, subordinated, and not listed on any exchange. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
